name: Route A: OPC-UA/Modbus tags -> same MQTT telemetry schema
info:
Replace the inject node with an OPC-UA (node-red-contrib-opcua) or Modbus
(node-red-contrib-modbus) read node that outputs the machine tags. Wire it into
the 'map tags' function, which formats the Telemetry schema and publishes to
factory/{line}/{station}/telemetry. Because a PLC exposes state directly, Route A
publishes to /telemetry (not /raw) — no inference needed.

name: map tags -> Telemetry schema
